1: Main Allah ke naam se shuru karta hoon, jo Ar-Rehman hai — bahut meharban — aur Ar-Raheem hai — nihayat reham karne wala. Allah ke yeh dono naam Arabi lafz 'rehmat' se nikle hain, jis ka matlab hai meharbani: yeh us ki rehmat ki azmat aur wusat ko sabit karte hain, aur yeh ke us ki rehmat har cheez ko ghere hue hai aur tamam jaandaron ko apne daaman mein liye hue hai. Har niyamat usi ki rehmat se hai, aur sab se bari rehmat mominon ko milti hai.
2: Tamam tareef Allah hi ke liye hai — us ki zaat, us ki sifaat aur us ke kaamon ke lihaz se — kyunke wohi har cheez ka paida karne wala hai. Har cheez usi ki hai aur wohi un ke tamam maamlaat ka intezam karne wala hai; woh baaz bandon ko khusoosi tor par niyamat deta hai aur tamam insaano ko aam tor par.
3: Allah ke do naam, Ar-Rehman aur Ar-Raheem, lafz 'rehmat' se nikle hain: yeh makhlooq ke liye us ki meharbani ko zahir karte hain, aur mominon ko is rehmat ka sab se bara hissa milta hai.
4: Wohi qayamat ke din ka maalik hai — woh din jis mein humein dobara zinda kiya jayega aur jo kuch humne kiya us ka badla diya jayega. Us din us ki tamam makhlooq apne aamaal ka hisaab degi aur un ka badla payegi. Us din Allah poochega: “Aaj baadshahi kis ki hai?” [Surah Ghafir: 16] Koi bhi, chahe us ka martaba kitna hi buland ho, jawab nahin dega; phir Allah khud hi farmayega: “Allah hi ki, jo Yakta hai, sab par ghalib hai.” [Surah Ghafir: 16]
5: Hum tere siwa na kisi ki ibadat karte hain aur na kisi ki itaat; hum tere saath kisi ko shareek nahin thehrate, aur apne tamam maamlaat mein sirf tujh hi se madad maangte hain. Har bhalai tere hi haath mein hai, aur tere siwa koi madadgar nahin.
6: Humein seedha raasta dikha — woh raasta jo teri farmanbardari ka hai aur jis mein koi kaji nahin — us par chalna aasan kar de aur humein us par qayam rakh.
7: Usi raaste par jis par tu ne apne un bandon ko chalaya jinhein tu ne hidayat ki niyamat di — jaise Ambiya (alaihimus salaam), Siddiqeen, Shuhada aur Saliheen ko. Kaise achhe hain yeh rafeeq! Aur humein un logon ke raaste se bacha jin par tera gazab hua, jinhon ne haqq ko jaan kar bhi us ki pairwi na ki — jaise Bani Israel ka haal tha; aur humein un logon ke raaste se bhi bacha jo bhatak gaye aur hidayat na pa sake, kyunke woh haqq ko talash karne aur us ki rehnumai lene mein gaflat karte rahe — jaise Nasara ka haal tha.
